value.name: Harmonic Oscillator (Overdriven)
value.note: While under the effects of Overdrive, your force and sonic resistance from Harmonic Oscillator is 2 higher (5 + half your level instead of 3 + half your level).

backfillRows.why: innovation-5: "You gain resistance equal to 3 + half your level to force and sonic damage. When under the effects of Overdrive, the resistance increases by 2." The FULL boosted value, not a +2, because the IWR merge takes the higher of two resistances for a type rather than adding them. Gated on the modification id ONLY (no classes:['inventor'] — modeRelevant ORs its gates, so a class gate would offer the mode to every inventor). ModeDef.resistances (types.ts:4651) is consumed by deriveDefenses beside feats/heritages/items, and modeGateIds (derive.ts:3394) carries ownedFeatureIds, which includes the inventor's chosen modifications (derive.ts:3450ff) — so the mode reaches exactly the inventor who took Harmonic Oscillator. Pinned by test/batch033-engine.test.ts 'harmonic-oscillator resistance rises while overdriven' against a mode patched in memory.
